g.text: fork() shares every frame; the first write copies one page
two tables, the same frames, all marked read-only
one fault, one copy; the other three stay shared
64 MB forked: the child reads all of it with 0 page faults and writes all of it with 16,384, one per page copied.
Until a page is written, PSS splits it between the two; after, each owns its copy.
